releaseNotes.zh-CN:
环境广场新增名称和地区搜索，地图预览更快捷。
环境页集中展示已保存列表，支持列表内多选删除，添加环境进入地图。
采集时同步海拔，选点保存可填写海拔；留空时保留真实 GPS 海拔。
releaseNotes.en:
Search the environment plaza by name or region and preview locations directly.
Manage saved environments in a dedicated list with multi-select deletion, and add environments from the map.
Capture altitude and optionally set it when saving a map point. Leave it blank to keep the real GPS altitude.
